# Changelog

## 1.0.0 - 2026-08-11

- Define the closed RFC 8949 section 4.2.3 language-neutral corpus.
- Pin 128 levels of nesting and a 1,048,576-byte encoded-item limit.
- Cover exact canonical encodings, heterogeneous map ordering, duplicate-key
  rejection, malformed wire classes, hostile lengths, and static errors.
- Add a generated C-compatible projection with an exact drift gate.
